args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in
2.9.4; staying on the 2.x line for compatibility.

args.body:
## What

Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; the fix is in **2.9.4**. Staying on the 2.x line to minimize upgrade risk.

## Checklist

- [x] Dependency bumped to a fixed version (2.9.4)
- [x] CI run ci-0001 passed on commit c8b8ab7878
